== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Program Trap (Japanese)|Program Trap]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67752 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(34, 17, 467, 615)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>cee560298eb5b1925fb51e0ca5a519e9aa7be9edd93869231563f4982f4a6c3e</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-7/74/Japanese-ANH-Program-Trap-SWCA-67752.jpg Internet Archive item].
